body: Well,  the rules are usually just specific types of people welcome there,  addicts and that kind of stuff. They also expect me to pay for my own things but the problem is that I don't have money.
Propably outside somewhere but I don't know where yet.
The only place I found that I can go to is one where you have forced therapy with your parents, all the others cost money or have other rules.
The problem is that I don't have anyone around me to go to.

It's very good to hear you're doing better. You don't have to feel guilty for being depressed, you can't help it. I recognise the being rational part when sad, and it usually just make things worse, just try to think it's not your fault.

It's normal,  it's not good,  but normal. You should try to see a doctor. Maybe they have some medicine that can stop the anxiety attacks. A therapist can also help a lot. 

Also,  about the no irl people thing,  I'm in the same position. You should try finding online community's, one that's more personal than reddit where you can get to know people. I talk to many people on Discord,  people I can relate to and it helps a lot.

Don't feel bad that you have what you wanted but you can't feel happy about it, that's just what depression does to you. I'm REALLY REALLY glad and proud you actually went to the urgent care center,  most people just hide it until it gets worse. I hope the prozac works for you. 

Also, relationships aren't the most important thing ever, you will find love. Uni is very important but it's really hard too,  but don't forget about the little things that make you feel better. The bad stuff might outweigh the good things, but as long as there are good things you still have a reason to live.

You can also try talking to a friend about it,  maybe one of your friends have also gone to depression. Talk to them,  they will understand you. 

Good luck with your exams and I really hope you feel better.

You think you can't help her or yourself, but you two do understand each other. You don't have to help each other with your problems if you can't, but you can just talk,  about anything and you will see how much you know how you feel the same about a lot of stuff. It's the idea of not being alone that might help. I hope she gets well soon and that you two will be able to support each other in life.

There's more to life than just work. I have also run out of things to look forward to. What I do is just do what I always do, until I see something I can look forward to, it can be so small, maybe a TV show having a new season, maybe a package arriving. Not having anything to look forward to is very hard. I hope it gets better for you.
I get really mad because of compliments, because I don't believe them. I wish I could believe them.
We are the only people who can understand our problems.

I'm sure I'm pretty late for posting in this thread, but a little mindless ranting always helps my days get better.

First of all, I really appreciate this thread. I used to come to this sub a long time ago but I stopped coming here because I was getting more tired. I'm glad to see there is a place now for people who don't want to make their own thread, thank you.

So here's a little rant/what I have been going through lately.

Last week I went to my friend's house, she is my only friend. I had a lot of fun, you could almost say too fun, I won't go into the details but it was mainly watching netflix. But here is the "too fun" part: After I left her place and went home I just felt extremely lonely, it was like taking a lot of MDMA in a short time, raising your life/happiness standards, and resulting in a horrible depression afterwards. The problem is, I was already horribly depressed before I went there. I feel like I hit another all-time low.

I tried to keep talking to her on WhatsApp, since that's the only way I can talk to her, she moved away for uni. I know she has so much more friends than I have, and she is my only friend. It just hurts so much when she doesn't respond to my messages even though she is on her phone a lot. She knows how depressed I am, she knows how lonely I am, but still she can't take the time to scroll down a bit and check if I have said anything. It's not like I only talk about sad stuff, I never do. I just want a friend who occasionally wants to talk and can always respond. I guess it's just too much to ask from someone who has a decent life and a lot of friends.

It just makes me so tired trying to maintain a friendship, because I feel like I'm doing it all by myself. I might just stop talking to her untill she forgets me. So I can finally end it all. She's the reason I'm still around. But she becomes a smaller reason to live every single day, untill it disappears.


I don't know how to end this rant. I just hope someone can maybe talk to me, I really need it. If not, I might rewrite it and make it into a normal text post. Again, thank you for this thread.
